name: Hall of Masks
summary: In the Hall of Masks, carved skulls loom over a bone-choked trench beneath the Swamp of Sorrows. The chamber marks a threshold to deeper passages in the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

sections.title: A Gruesome Threshold
sections.body: Past the staircase from the Broken Hall, you reach a central junction in the Sunken Temple. Stylized skull masks line its stone walls. A deep trench choked with discarded bones cuts across the floor, though its purpose remains unknown. From here, passages lead to the Butchery, the Chamber of Blood, and the Den of the Caller.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Masks located?
faq.answer: The Hall of Masks lies inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar beneath the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows. Descend past the Broken Hall near the sunken complex's entrance to reach it.

faq.q: Why is it called the Hall of Masks?
faq.answer: The Hall of Masks takes its name from the massive carved skull masks mounted on its walls. They loom over all who pass through the temple corridors.

faq.q: What was the purpose of the trench in the floor?
aliases: why are there bones in the floor
faq.answer: Bones litter the trench, but its exact purpose remains unknown.

faq.q: Where do the passages from this hall lead?
aliases: where does hall of masks lead
faq.answer: Passages from the Hall of Masks lead deeper into the temple, toward the Butchery, the Chamber of Blood, and the Den of the Caller.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can see how far the Atal'ai zealots went in their desperate pursuit of Hakkar the Soulflayer.
As a priest, you can read the Atal'ai's dark practices in the chamber's grim design and bone-filled trench. The trench's precise use remains unknown.
